items.reason: Gap 0 describes a retry overlapping the first delivery so both pass the Set check before the id is added, processing the event twice.
Gap 1 says the dedupe key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a forged or changed header can bypass deduplication.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on several processes or replicas; the concurrency gap concerns jobs within the one queue.
